status: PROVISIONAL -- feasibility/method result, NOT a validated genuine profile

calibration_population.warning: Only 2 independent physical watches are available in this corpus's calibration gen_candidate pool. This is far below any sample size that supports a statistically validated genuine distribution. All bands below are literal descriptive statistics of this tiny sample, kept only because the experiment's own architecture requires a frozen artifact to demonstrate the pipeline end-to-end. Do not treat any band below as production-ready.

not_authenticated_ground_truth: gen_candidate means source-labelled genuine candidate only, per this project's standing rule. Not independently authenticated.

selected_core_features.name: apex_r_simple
selected_core_features.definition: 12-triangle apex point, affine-normalised canonical radial coordinate along the independently-established 12 axis (axis_coords.canonical_axis_components, t_radial component).
selected_core_features.coordinate_system: canonical dial-radius units (same scale as master.MINUTE_TRACK_R=0.891, master.DIAL_EDGE_R=1.0); r=0 at dial centre.
selected_core_features.confidence_requirements: triangle_segmented=true; triangle_confidence heuristic reported alongside, no fixed cutoff applied yet.
selected_core_features.minimum_peer_evidence: none for this simple form (does not require the round-marker corridor).
selected_core_features.known_limitations: n=2 physical watches; within-watch MAD 0.0065/0.0063 (tight in this tiny sample, but not validated); tilt correlation in this sample was weak (r=-0.06) but n is too small to trust.

selected_core_features.name: base_r_simple
selected_core_features.definition: 12-triangle base-centre point, affine-normalised canonical radial coordinate along the 12 axis.
selected_core_features.coordinate_system: canonical dial-radius units, r=0 at dial centre.
selected_core_features.known_limitations: n=2 physical watches; correlated with centre_r_simple (r=0.92 in-sample) -- largely redundant with the retained-but-secondary centre_r_simple, kept separately for its direct overlay/physical meaning (base gate) rather than as independent statistical information.

selected_core_features.name: centroid_tangential_offset_canonical
selected_core_features.definition: Signed tangential (perpendicular-to-axis) canonical displacement of the triangle's contour centroid from the nominal 12 axis. Positive = clockwise.
selected_core_features.coordinate_system: canonical dial-radius units, 0 = exactly on the nominal 12 axis.
selected_core_features.minimum_peer_evidence: none directly, but the axis itself depends on the affine ellipse+roll basis (established elsewhere as reliable for direction).
selected_core_features.known_limitations: n=2 physical watches; strong apparent tilt correlation in-sample (r=-0.84) that could reflect genuine tilt sensitivity of this specific measurement OR simply the tiny sample -- flagged as an open question, not resolved here. Directly addresses the most common community-reported 12-marker QC concern (left/right shift) per the refreshed shared research knowledge base.

selected_core_features.name: symmetry_axis_angular_deviation_deg
selected_core_features.definition: Angular deviation (degrees) of the apex-to-base-centre line from the nominal 12 axis, in the canonical axis-aligned frame.
selected_core_features.coordinate_system: degrees, 0 = perfectly aligned with the nominal 12 axis.
selected_core_features.confidence_requirements: triangle_segmented=true; also report triangle_axis_agreement_deg (independent PCA cross-check) alongside as a segmentation-quality signal.
selected_core_features.minimum_peer_evidence: none directly (axis direction from the affine basis).
selected_core_features.known_limitations: WEAKEST of the retained features on available evidence: within-watch MAD was 2.8 and 6.7 degrees on the two calibration watches -- substantially noisier than the radial features. Retained provisionally because orientation is the most common community-reported 12-marker QC concern, but this feature needs materially more calibration data before its stated range should be trusted for anything beyond illustration.

selected_core_features.name: base_width_over_height
selected_core_features.definition: Ratio of canonical base-corner-to-corner distance to canonical apex-to-base-centre distance (both distances computed in the 2D canonical (t_radial, t_tangential) plane around the 12 axis).
selected_core_features.known_limitations: n=2 physical watches; one watch's within-watch MAD (0.157) was much larger than the other's (0.030), suggesting this ratio may be more segmentation-sensitive on some photos than others -- not yet understood with this sample size.

secondary_reported_not_core: centre_r_simple (redundant with base_r_simple, corr=0.92 in-sample; shown on overlay as the centre gate for human interpretability)
base_to_minute_track_gap_simple (deterministic transform of base_r_simple; shown on overlay per the local base-to-minute-track bracket requirement)
base_line_angular_deviation_deg (close call, not promoted to core to keep the profile compact)

apex_r_projective / centre_r_projective / base_r_projective and their minute-track-gap/round-marker-ratio derivatives (round-marker-corridor availability was only 3/7 images in this sample -- reported in parallel for future comparison once more calibration data exists, not yet promoted over the simple forms; see research write-up for the full simple-vs-projective comparison)

rejected_features.name: base_half_width_symmetry
rejected_features.reason: Tautologically ~0 (1e-16, floating-point noise) under the current segmentation method: base_centre is defined as the exact midpoint of the found left/right corners, so this quantity cannot express real asymmetry with the current corner-finding algorithm. Would need an independent asymmetry estimator (e.g. contour arc-length on each side) to be meaningful.

rejected_features.name: centroid_position_within_span
rejected_features.reason: Fully determined by apex_r_simple, base_r_simple and centre_r_simple together -- redundant given those are already tracked.

rejected_features.name: apex_to_base_span_simple / apex_to_base_span_projective
rejected_features.reason: Deterministic difference of two already-selected/reported features (base_r - apex_r); reportable as a derived quantity but not an independently selected feature.
